services.value: Beckton provides full service monitoring and analytical environmental laboratory services, including sampling services (e.g., water and wastewater sampling, soil sampling, groundwater sampling) and analytical services for environmental samples. The site lists capabilities such as QA/QC programs, troubleshooting/analytical consultation, interpretation of results from complex matrices, and instrumentation-based analyses (e.g., NPDES discharge monitoring, PRDOH drinking water analysis, various chemical and microbiological analyses).
